In response, the Petitioner vide affidavit dated 12.10.2021 has furnished details after serving the Respondents. On scrutiny of the details submitted by the Petitioner, it is observed that out of the total claim of the Petitioner for Rs.155.04 lakh, an amount of Rs.151.86 lakh corresponds to impact of wage revision of Petitioner‟s employees. It is noticed that out of the said claim of Rs.151.86 lakh, an amount of Rs.3.82 lakh during the period 2016-19, pertains to payment of PRP/exgratia to Petitioner‟s employees. As such, in line with the consistent methodology adopted by the Commission, the said amount of Rs.3.82 lakh has been excluded from the claim of the Petitioner for wage revision of its employees. Hence, the impact of wage revision of Petitioner‟s employees stands revised as Rs.148.04 lakh. Accordingly, the total claim of the Petitioner in respect of the wage revision impact reduces from Rs.155.04 lakh to Rs.151.22 lakh.
